description: Isolated executable synthetic composition build: structured extraction -> contextual feedback analysis -> prerequisite-aware next-action planning.

execution.success: One JSON document on stdout; exit code 0
execution.invalid_input: One JSON error document on stdout; exit code 2

shared_input_schema.top_level: Exactly sources, claims, feedback, actions; each is a list.

evidence.start: integer inclusive Python Unicode character offset, not a byte offset
evidence.end: integer exclusive offset; start < end within source text

claim.value: nonempty literal string occurring in at least one cited span
claim.evidence: list of evidence spans; empty means unsupported

feedback.applies_to: map of known extracted fields to expected literal values; all conditions must match
feedback.evidence: list of evidence spans; empty means inactive

action.title: nonempty string
action.prerequisites: unique existing action IDs forming a directed acyclic graph
action.theme_weights: map of theme labels to signed integer weights
action.evidence: list of catalog/source spans; empty blocks the action

validation_policy: Unknown keys, missing keys, incorrect types, duplicate record IDs, duplicate JSON keys, invalid spans, unknown references, repeated evidence spans, repeated prerequisites, nonstandard JSON constants and cyclic prerequisites are rejected.
Boolean values are not accepted as integers.
IDs are namespaced by collection; all stages share the sources namespace.
Absent evidence is represented explicitly rather than inferred or fabricated.

shared_internal_logic: One schema validator and one source index serve all three stages.
The shared grounded() helper attaches exact source substrings to spans.
The shared deduplicate() helper deduplicates identical provenance spans.
Extraction statuses resolved, missing and contradictory are reused directly for feedback applicability and action eligibility.

handoffs.contract: Literal claims are grouped into field candidates with source spans. Only a single evidenced candidate resolves a field. Feedback applicability compares expected values against resolved extraction; missing, conflicting and mismatched context makes that feedback inactive with explicit reasons.
Every required field must resolve before an action is eligible. Required values and their evidence are carried into selected steps. Blocked prerequisites also prevent downstream actions.

Action score is base priority plus the sum of theme weight times active support-minus-oppose record count. Both sides of disagreement and their evidence are preserved even when the net contribution is zero. Inactive and neutral feedback do not affect priority.

planning_policy.selection: Greedily choose highest score among eligible actions, using action ID as deterministic tie-break, then repeat once.
planning_policy.prerequisites: Step two may depend on step one, explicitly conditional on actual completion; planning does not execute either action.
planning_policy.short_plans: Return partial for one possible step and no_eligible_action for zero; never fabricate an action to fill the plan.
planning_policy.unselected: Report intrinsic field/evidence blocks, unscheduled prerequisites, or two_step_limit.

optional_callback.input: Deep copy of the complete deterministic result.
optional_callback.output: Exactly {steps: [{action_id, source_ids, explanation}, ...]} matching planned IDs, order, length and source IDs.
optional_callback.safety_boundary: Cannot change selected actions, scores, evidence spans or source IDs. Supplemental prose is labeled semantic_verification: not_performed. Invalid callback output raises InputError. Callback exceptions propagate to the API caller.
optional_callback.verification: Tests cover valid synthesis, changed IDs, changed sources, reordered or removed steps, empty text and attempted mutation of a copied score.

synthetic_fixtures: baseline: evidenced owner/onboarding/email/low context, opposing setup feedback, three catalog actions
support-only: active setup concern increases setup-review priority
missing-channel: extraction absence blocks pilot but leaves unrelated actions eligible
contradictory-goal: two evidenced goal values block setup review and deactivate context-dependent feedback
test-local labeled mutations: absent evidence, context mismatch, malformed schema/spans, duplicates, cyclic prerequisites, callback tampering and empty input

explicit_cross_stage_assertions: Deleting channel evidence replaces run-pilot with review-messaging.
Active setup feedback changes the first action from review-messaging to review-setup and unlocks run-pilot as the second action.
Deleting extracted goal deactivates matching feedback and changes ranking even when review-setup has no direct required field.
Contradictory goals deactivate feedback, block review-setup and prevent its dependent pilot.
Selected step grounding contains extraction, both disagreeing feedback sources and action catalog evidence.

limitations: Synthetic local verification only; no production, accuracy, user-study or external benchmark claim.
Structured extraction consumes caller-provided literal claim candidates and validated source spans. It does not discover arbitrary entities from unannotated prose.
Theme labels, stances, action titles and weights are supplied by the caller; span validity does not prove semantic correctness.
Different values for a field are treated as unresolved contradictions without recency, authority or synonym resolution.
Duplicate IDs and exact repeated spans within a record are rejected, but semantically duplicate records with different IDs are not detected.
Feedback is equally weighted per active record and is not a statistically representative sample.
Greedy two-step selection is not a global utility optimizer. All prerequisite work starts uncompleted; no persistent execution state.
Supplemental callback prose is not semantically checked for unsupported assertions, although action identity and original grounding are immutable.
No concurrency, durability, adversarial resource-exhaustion hardening or external integrations were evaluated.

measurement_scope.token_accounting: Not estimated or aggregated; parent measures the isolated session.
